_comment: A reviewer reads and signs. It must not author, because anything it authors
loses the approval it would otherwise have given: GitHub forbids approving
The `reviewer` persona already sets disallowedTools for Edit/Write/NotebookEdit;
this covers the shell, which that field does not.
disableRemoteControl: a reviewer runs for minutes, posts a verdict, and is
retired. It has no reason to be drivable from a phone, and every session that
connects Remote Control leaves an entry in the Claude app's session list that
OUTLIVES it -- `offline`, permanent, and clearable only by hand in the app.
Six had piled up by 2026-09-11, one of them twice. Verified by spawning a
background session with this key: it never appeared in ListAgents at all,
while every reviewer spawned without it left an entry.
